problem.label: The Problem
problem.headline: Startups don't need more design theatre. They need product clarity.

items.title: Your product is hard to explain
items.body: It takes three paragraphs and a diagram before anyone gets it.

items.title: Your demo needs narration
items.body: The product can't carry the story without a founder talking over it.

items.title: Your AI feels powerful but unclear
items.body: The capability is real, but the experience doesn't make it obvious or trustworthy.

items.title: Your product undersells your company.
items.body: The capability is real, but the experience doesn't make it obvious or trustworthy.

solution.label: Proposed Solution

steps.title: Diagnose
steps.body: I'll review the product, demo, and onboarding to find what's unclear and why.

steps.title: Plan
steps.body: I'll turn that into prioritized fixes your team can pick up next sprint.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: I'll Design and work with engineering until the fixes are live.

solution.closing: For founders building complex B2B, AI, or dev tools who need senior product judgment without a full-time hire.
